About the event

If you currently have a startup idea, identify yourself as a founder, or want to join a startup but don’t know how to get started, you are more than welcome to join the Co-Founders Wanted! event.

Co-Founders Wanted! is a hands-on co-founder matchmaking event designed for solo founders and those who are serious about building startups.




What to expect




Practical workshops and moderated 1-on-1 meetings that will help participants present their background, identify their strengths, and connect through focused conversations.




Program of the event




15:30 - 16:00 Welcome drinks and registration
